name: azure-cli
description: Azure CLI embedded Python runtime with Azure SDK and extensions

tools.description: Azure CLI Python 3.12 runtime with full Azure SDK integration
tools.usage:
python -m azure.cli # Launch Azure CLI directly
python -c "from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential; print('Auth ready')" # Test Azure auth
python -m pip show azure-cli # Show Azure CLI package info
python azure_automation.py # Run custom Azure automation scripts
python -m azure.cli --help # Show all available Azure commands

tools.description: Silent Azure CLI Python runtime for background automation
tools.usage: pythonw azure_batch_job.py # Run Azure batch operations silently\npythonw -c "import azure.cli.core; azure.cli.core.main()" # Headless Azure CLI\npythonw monitor_resources.py # Background Azure resource monitoring
